namespace.description: The namespace this chart CREATES and installs its page objects into. It is the RBAC boundary the chart exists for — a group with no RoleBinding here cannot `list` the page roots, so the portal sidebar never shows them and the page body 403s on a deep link. The release itself stays wherever the composition is created; only the page objects live here.
namespace.title: namespace

observability.description: The snowplow SLI sub-page. 74 of this chart's templates are gated on it and render nothing when it is off, which is the default.

reconcileTracing.description: Show the reconcile PERFORMANCE section of /observability (p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput, phase breakdown, per-composition reconcile table). Off by default: it reads reconcile tracing metrics, and an install without them renders empty panels, which reads as broken rather than absent. It also shows "Last reconcile by composition" on the Reconciliation tab, dated from the same reconcile traces.
reconcileTracing.title: reconcileTracing

observability.title: observability

observabilityConsoleUrl.description: Optional URL of the external observability console (the clickstack/HyperDX UI). When set, a "View in console" link appears on /observability and the trace page links each trace at <url>/trace/<TraceId>; empty hides both. No default: HyperDX has no public route on the platform, so there is no address to assume.
observabilityConsoleUrl.title: observabilityConsoleUrl

readerGroups.description: Groups granted read of these pages in `namespace`. A group listed here sees /observability in the sidebar and can open it; a group absent cannot list the page roots, so the entry never renders. `devs` is deliberately NOT a default — keeping it out is the point of the split (#261). No schema default: the installer applies schema defaults, so one here would silently re-assert itself over a group set through componentValues. The chart default lives in values.yaml instead.
readerGroups.title: readerGroups

tracesHiddenService.description: A service whose spans the Traces tab leaves out while no Service filter is chosen, with a note in the filter bar saying so; picking it in the Service filter shows them. The default is HyperDX's own Node instrumentation, about 97% of all spans. Empty hides nothing. Only letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen: the chart refuses to render anything else, because the value goes into SQL. No schema default: the installer applies schema defaults over values.yaml, so the default lives in values.yaml.
tracesHiddenService.title: tracesHiddenService
